# opnsense_bind_forward_domain (Data Source)

Zones whose queries BIND forwards to other servers (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ Forward Zones**, plugin `os-bind`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the BIND forward zone.

### Read-Only

- `domainname` (String) Set the name for this zone. Both forward and reverse zones may be specified, i.e. example.com or 0.168.192.in-addr.arpa.
- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable this zone.
- `forwardserver` (Set of String) Set the IP address of server to forward requests to.
